verdict: No paid activity this period; organic presence is holding but softening.
narrative: Maadi Law ran no paid advertising across Meta or Google in the last 28 days, resulting in zero paid leads. Your Google Business Profile was the only active lead signal, generating 94 total actions — 20 calls, 40 direction requests, and 34 website clicks — entirely through organic visibility. Over the last 7 days, GBP activity dropped 21.74% versus the prior 7 days, and Instagram reach slipped 4.3%, a pattern consistent with organic channels losing ground without paid traffic to support them. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore inbound volume and stop further erosion of visibility.
